Class BookArray

java.lang.Object
BookArray
public class BookArray extends Object
A class used for the Runner.ListB() program. Its got some basic functions, its main purpose is for the ability to wrap text by word. The BookArray class has a reference to a Book object when its created, details in the constructor doc.

      The big deal for this class, arguably the entire reason the class exists.
